test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Mother said, “You must stay indoors to remain safe.”

options.text: Mother told me that I have to stay indoors to remain safe.
Mother told me that I should stay indoors to remain safe.
Mother told me that I would stay indoors to remain safe.
Mother told me that I would have to stay indoors to remain safe.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Mother told me that I should stay indoors to remain safe.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an **assertive sentence.**
 
• While** changing the narration of an assertive sentence,** we need to follow steps - 
 
 
• The **reporting verb said** changes to '**told'. **( This is because we use told when we normally say who is spoken to which in this case is **me.** In other assertive sentences which does not have a direct personal object, the reporting verb said remains unchanged.)
 
• The **conjunction 'that'** is used in place of commas and inverted commas. 
 
• The **second person 'you' **in the direct speech should be changed to the **third person ****me.**
 
• The **modal verb 'must'** changes to **should.**
 
 
 
• Eventually, we will get the final sentence- **"Mother told me that I should stay indoors to remain safe.​"**
